description.zh: 结束时间（日期后默认拼接23:59:59）
description.en: The end time. The time 23:59:59 is appended to the date by default.

description.zh: 开始时间（日期后默认拼接00:00:00）
description.en: The start time. The time 00:00:00 is appended to the date by default.

description.zh: 发票申请 Id（对应 DescribeInvoiceForIsv 接口返回结果中的 Result.Id）
description.en: The invoice application ID. This value corresponds to Result.Id in the response of the DescribeInvoiceForIsv operation.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为50。默认值为10。(未启用此参数)
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10. (This parameter is not enabled.).

description.zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值。(未启用此参数)
description.en: The pagination token returned by this call. (This parameter is not enabled.).
The page number. Pages start from page 1.
The number of instances per page.

description.zh:
当前发票状态
- 申请中：0
- 已完成：1
description.en:
The current invoice status. Valid values:
- 0: processing
- 1: completed.

description.zh:
发票类型，为空代表默认查询所有类型
- 数字电子普通发票：2
- 数字电子专用发票：3
description.en:
The invoice type. If this parameter is left empty, all types are queried by default. Valid values:
- 2: digital electronic general invoice
- 3: digital electronic special invoice.
The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the customer.

title.zh: 查询云市场供应商店铺的发票信息
title.en: Query invoice information of an Alibaba Cloud marketplace supplier store

descriptions.zh:
根据授权码查询业务信息首先验证授权码是否有效。

- 授权码无效，返回错误信息

- 授权码有效，返回授权信息
descriptions.en:
Queries business information based on an authorization code. The system first verifies whether the authorization code is valid.

- If the authorization code is invalid, an error message is returned.

- If the authorization code is valid, the authorization information is returned.
